notes.title: Courier Tale Playtest Demo V004
notes.content:
This playtest update is updated to the version of the Courier Tale demo that was shown at Perth Games Festival 2021.

[list]
[*] Some typos fixed.
[*] Some extra sound added or changed.
[*] Added some extra menu icons.
[*] Added graphic for collector card.
[/list]

There is a known issue where the Steam demo is not showing the custom Courier Tale square font and is instead showing a default system fault.
